data.name: Hadeed
data.gender_notes: Hadeed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who provides and donates to others. The name Hadeed carries the meaning “Giver, Donor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hadeed usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, donor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hadeed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Donor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hadeed total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: حديد
in_arabic.meaning: حديد يعني الحديد أو المعدن الصلب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حديد مشتق من الجذر العربي 'حدد' والذي يعني 'حديد' أو 'معدن صلب'. ورد ذكر الحديد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحديد، وهي السورة 57 في ترتيب سور القرآن. الحديد هو معدن قوي ومتين، ويرمز الاسم إلى الصلابة والقوة.

in_urdu.name: حدید
in_urdu.meaning: حدید کا مطلب ہے لوہا یا مضبوط دھات
in_urdu.long_meaning: حدید نام عربی جڑ 'حدد' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'لوہا' یا 'مضبوط دھات'. یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم مقام رکھتا ہے کیونکہ قرآن کی ایک سورة کا نام 'سورة الحديد' ہے. لوہا ایک مضبوط اور متین دھات ہے، اور یہ نام مضبوطی اور سختی کی علامت ہے.

in_hindi.name: हदीद
in_hindi.meaning: हदीद का अर्थ है लोहा या मजबूत धातु
in_hindi.long_meaning: हदीद नाम अरबी मूल 'حدد' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'लोहा' या 'मजबूत धातु'. इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में है क्योंकि कुरआन की एक सूर का नाम 'सूरतुल हदीद' है. लोहा एक मजबूत और कठोर धातु है, और यह नाम मजबूती और सख्ती का प्रतीक है.

in_pashto.name: حديد
in_pashto.meaning: حديد د لويه يا قوي فلز معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: حديد نوم د عربي ريښې 'حدد' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې معنی يې 'لوۍ' يا 'قوي فلز' دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو دودیزو ارزښتونو کې ځای لري، ځکه چې قرآن کريم يوه سورة 'سورت الحديد' نوم لري. لوۍ يو مضبوط او کلک فلز دی، او دا نوم د مضبوطۍ او کلکوالي نښه ده.

in_english.name: Hadeed
in_english.meaning: Hadeed means iron or strong metal
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hadeed is derived from the Arabic root 'حدد' (haddad), meaning 'iron' or 'strong metal'. This name holds significance in Islamic tradition as it is also the title of a Quranic surah, Surah Al-Hadeed (57). Iron is a strong and durable metal, symbolizing strength, resilience, and fortitude. In Islamic culture, the name Hadeed is often chosen for its powerful connotations and historical religious significance.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: حديد

Those named "Hadeed" are often seen as community leaders and role models who invest their time, energy, and resources to help others. The name inspires individuals to contribute to their communities by providing essential resources, knowledge, or support to those in need.

This name reminds us that true wealth and success comes from serving others and being a blessing to those around us. It is a powerful reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's hadith, "Whoever relieves a believer's distress in this world, Allah will relieve his distress in the Hereafter." A person named "Hadeed" strives to embody the teachings of kindness, compassion, and unity, which brings them closer to Allah and helps them cultivate a deeper spiritual connection.
